label: 208.Coppersmith_Barbet
summary: The Coppersmith Barbet (Psilopogon barbet) is an avian species characterized by specialized plumage and foraging adaptations. It primarily inhabits tropical moist lowland forests, city gardens, and groves, where its diet consists primarily of wild figs, drupes, berries, and flower buds.
habitat: Tropical moist lowland forests, city gardens, and groves
diet: Wild figs, drupes, berries, and flower buds
